chapter: Early years in Brenham and Houston
title: Carnival trip to Mexico and Alexander's Ragtime Jazz Band in Houston
summary: He runs off with a carnival to Mexico, returns to Houston and forms Alexander's Ragtime Jazz Band, playing at Don Robey's Harlem Grill.

story.theme_name: Brass bands, parades and jazz funerals
story.community_name: First paid gigs: pay, bands and young beginnings

blocks.x: Yeah. I want to get that myself up. Well, now, let's see. I was telling you about going down to Houston there. And I learned to lead a bunch of fellas, what the responsibilities was. I did pretty good after that. I got started. And I went off with a, left here, left Sid Isles, and went off with a carnival, carnival show. The boys said they were going down to Mexico, and I'd never been to Mexico, and I wanted to get away and go down to Mexico. So I just forgot about school, went on down there. The old man Sid Isles, well, he had promised the old man to take care of me like a father, which he did. I lived right in the house with him there. And he wouldn't give me my clothes. And the only way I could get my clothes, I had to write a letter and put it inside another envelope and tell the boy, a friend of mine, when you get this, to mail it to the old man, tell him I'm at home. So he'll send my clothes home. I sent them home to my mother. I got my mother to send them to me after he sent them home to me. So that's where I got my clothes down in Mexico. I stayed down there now. I made good down around the border. I got my mother to call them down this border right now. Texas Valley down there. So I came on back, back Houston again, got buried with Houston again. And we organized a band there called Alexander's Ragtime Jazz Band. Old Dave Alexander. We named it after him. He was well known. He worked on the ice truck, well known a lot of people, a lot of people, a lot of them, kind of felt like they keep you laughing all the time. About what year was that? That was long about 1921. Yeah, about 21, maybe about 1920. Anyway, we all got this band and we got lots of work. We just went to clean up around there. About stuff We were playing down there for Don Roby. He had this place, what's the name of that place, Don? Harlem Grill. Harlem Grill. He was operating this Harlem Grill and we head out playing down there. We closed Duke up.
